cross_validation.index_space: global CSV indices; use baseline.load_dataset()['cv'] for TRAIN-local arrays
cross_validation.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of the three held-out-fold log losses
cross_validation.candidate_order: sort parameter names lexicographically; retain each value list order; rightmost parameter changes fastest
cross_validation.tie_break: smallest zero-based candidate_index among exactly equal mean losses

common_training.encoding: fold-local DictVectorizer(sparse=False) applied only to the raw allowlist
common_training.numeric_scaling: fold-local StandardScaler on all encoded columns for both linear routes; no scaling for tree routes
common_training.numerical_warning_policy: ConvergenceWarning, RuntimeWarning, nonfinite scores or unexpected fit errors fail the run; preserve evidence, do not silently drop them
common_training.known_zero_feature_policy: LASSO candidates selecting zero encoded features on any fold are explicitly ineligible; record every fold status and never substitute all features, a constant model or replacement candidates
common_training.ineligible_candidate_scoring: no partial-fold mean; eligibility requires all three fold fits to complete without the known zero-feature condition
common_training.no_valid_candidate_policy: no completed model or validation claim; preserve the unsuccessful run and review a versioned plan before another search
common_training.final_refit_zero_feature_policy: if the selected LASSO configuration retains zero features on all TRAIN rows, fail the run; do not select another candidate using validation

routes.method: Squared-loss LASSO encoded-feature selector followed by L2 Logistic Regression

selector.retain_rule: absolute coefficient strictly greater than coefficient_threshold; exclude the intercept

routes.dependency_handoff: D must pin an exact XGBoost version compatible with these parameters and the shared core environment before fitting; XGBoost is not installed or locked by this plan

limits: This JSON predeclares a search; it is not an implemented training launcher or evidence of completed training.
Twelve attempted candidates per route is not equal wall-clock cost, estimator complexity or effective search capacity; report eligible counts and measured timings.
The committed three-candidate Logistic Regression is a separate historical reference, not the newly budget-matched twelve-candidate route.
Validation comparisons are development evidence; repeated inspection cannot create an untouched final assessment.
Changing data, grids, calibration, seeds, preprocessing or budgets requires a coordinated new protocol version, not a silent method-specific change.
